title: Sugar Delight like sweet berries
description: Retextures SugarDelight berries to match the vanilla Minecraft style, inspired by sweet berries. Includes raspberry, blackberry, and blueberry (and dried variants).
body:
This resource pack retextures berries from SugarDelight to match the vanilla style of Minecraft, inspired by sweet berries.

The following items are reworked:

• Raspberry

• Dried Raspberry

• Blackberry

• Dried Blackberry

• Blueberry

• Dried Blueberry

All textures are adjusted to better fit the vanilla aesthetic, making them blend seamlessly with the base game.
